subject: Four fictional Nevada-history resort illustration sets plus Despicable's: 100 runtime PNGs and four shared suit SVGs
method: Original image_gen illustration sheets, transparent payout cutouts and four new centered heritage paintings; lossless sprite packaging with measured visible-content bounds. Four cabinet faces are baked from the actual SlotStage renderer. No historical photographs, scanned playing cards or existing casino artwork were copied.
historical_interpretation: Mining, railroads, dam construction and rocket-engine research inspire fictional figures and designs. No real casino branding or agency insignia is depicted.
shared_suits: Original continuous symmetric SVG silhouettes, drawn as one texture per suit
portrait_edits: Twelve individually edited transparent cutouts preserve the fictional court figures while removing paper backgrounds and neighboring-cell fragments

despicables.method: Original built-in imagegen cutout and decor sheets; lossless inspected-region packaging; cabinet face baked from the actual three-reel game renderer.
